commits.message: test(api): order producer-emission outbox reads by write order, not NULL position
test(api): read integration database URLs through one helper, drop dead fallbacks

diagnosis.cause: outboxOf() read integration_outbox ORDER BY position. position is NULL at INSERT (fxl-contracts OUTBOX_INSERT writes NULL) and only the elected publisher assigns it after commit; no publisher runs in this test, so every row tied on NULL and Postgres returned them in arbitrary order. The two .slice(before) assertions (test.ts:141 revert voids, test.ts:157 cancel-contract voids) then sometimes picked earlier 'active' rows from the win transaction.
diagnosis.evidence: 18/20 isolated runs failed before the fix; failing assertions were test.ts:141 (17x, together with :157) and test.ts:157 (1x), both 'expected false to be true' on every(state==='voided') over a slice.
diagnosis.fix: ORDER BY created_at, id. created_at defaults to now() (the business transaction start), strictly increasing across the test's sequential transactions; id only breaks ties inside one transaction, which no assertion depends on. position is still never assigned at INSERT; no sleeps or retries.

checks.api_test_integration_full: PASS 41 files / 305 tests (as fxl_sales_test, all URLs localhost:5006)

notes: Deviation from plan path: the helper lives at apps/api/src/db/__tests__/test-database-urls.ts, not apps/api/test/rls/test-database-urls.ts. src/ integration files (outbox-adapter.integration.test.ts, settlement-test-cleanup.ts) must import it and apps/api/tsconfig.json has rootDir ./src, so importing from test/rls fails type-check with TS6059 (reproduced). One implementation, imported by all 34 test/rls and src importers; it imports nothing.

testDatabaseUrls() returns {appUrl, adminUrl, migrateUrl} from the values setup-env.ts wrote to process.env and throws naming the missing variables otherwise. Replacement is behaviour-neutral: under setup-env every old chain already resolved to the same variable.

Five files (funcoes-schema-migration, hub-bff-login-supersede, leads-schema-migration, produtos-servicos-schema-migration, proposal-schema-migration) only used APP_DB_URL as the admin fallback, so they now bind only ADMIN_DB_URL.
vitest.config.ts comment now describes TEST_DATABASE_URL / ADMIN_DATABASE_URL / TEST_MIGRATE_DATABASE_URL, global-setup and setup-env.
Test env vars were exported only in the subshells that ran tests; no leftover processes; no nexo/ notes; no merge or push.
